# appdynamics_schedule (Data Source)

Retrieves the details of a specific AppDynamics alerting schedule by ID. Use the appdynamics_schedules data source to discover schedule_id values.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "appdynamics_schedule" "business_hours" {
  application_id = 42
  schedule_id     = 62867
}

output "business_hours_configuration" {
  value = data.appdynamics_schedule.business_hours.schedule_configuration
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (Number) ID of the business application this schedule belongs to.
- `schedule_id` (Number) ID of the schedule to retrieve.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `schedule_configuration` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schedule_configuration))
- `timezone` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--schedule_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schedule_configuration`

Read-Only:

- `day` (List of String)
- `days` (List of String)
- `end_cron` (String)
- `end_date` (String)
- `end_time` (String)
- `occurrence` (String)
- `schedule_frequency` (String) One of ONE_TIME, DAILY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY_SPECIFIC_DATE, MONTHLY_SPECIFIC_DAY, CUSTOM.
- `start_cron` (String)
- `start_date` (String)
- `start_time` (String)
